### A Prayer for Patience in the Waiting Season of Life
Author: Carolyn Dale Newell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/a-prayer-for-patience-in-the-waiting-season-of-life.html
Passage: James 5:7
Points:
- Waiting seasons are often filled with discomfort, but believers are called to learn how to wait well.
- Like a farmer waiting for crops, believers can trust God is actively working beneath the surface.
- God operates on an exact timetable, making difficult seasons opportunities to grow in obedience.
- Biblical waiting is active daily faithfulness rather than passive idleness.
- God never abandons His people in their wait, supplying daily mercy and grace to sustain them.

### Squirrelly Persistence
Author: Ramona Davis
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-22-2005-1336349.html
Passage: James 5:11
Points:
- Trials and opposition often tempt believers to lose heart, grow weary, or turn bitter toward God.
- Job serves as a model of steadfast endurance through suffering, showing God's merciful outcome.
- Standing firm requires anchoring our minds daily in God's promises.
- Rather than quitting, believers must rely on Christ by bringing their burdens directly to Him.
- Choosing to praise God amidst heartbreak purifies faith and honors His unchanging goodness.
